tools.name: scrape
tools.description: Scrape a URL through Sessemi, bypassing Cloudflare, DataDome, and Akamai anti-bot protection. Returns the page content (HTML or JSON depending on the target's Content-Type). Costs credits per request.

country.description: Two-letter country code for geo-targeting (e.g. FR, US, DE). Auto-selects residential proxies.

render.description: Force browser rendering for JS-heavy pages.

session.description: Session name for cookie/IP persistence across multiple scrapes. Same session = same cookies and IP.

headers.description: Custom HTTP headers as JSON string. Example: '{"Accept": "application/json"}'

tools.name: credits
tools.description: Check your Sessemi API credit balance — remaining credits, tier, and usage.
